title: Kanan Jarrus
subtitle: Rebel
description: Once known as Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume, Kanan Jarrus went into hiding after he witnessed his master, Depa Billaba, killed by clone troopers during Order 66. Jarrus later fell in with a hotshot pilot named Hera Syndulla and the two formed what would be known as the Ghost crew. Kanan would go on to rediscover his Jedi path and take on his own apprentice with Ezra Bridger.
